description: See your real screen, viewport, pixel ratio, color depth and orientation values live — updates instantly on resize or rotation.

faqs.a: screen.width/height are the full display in CSS pixels; window.innerWidth/innerHeight are the current browser viewport, which shrinks with devtools or sidebars.
devicePixelRatio (e.g. 2 on Retina) — CSS pixels are multiplied by it to get physical device pixels.
Yes — the values refresh on window resize and on orientation change, so rotate your phone to watch them update.

howto: Open the tool — your live screen and viewport stats appear immediately.
Resize the window or rotate your device to watch values update.
